```plato
    // The lowest-numbered corner at a vertex: the ring walk's starting point.
    // Scans downwards so the last match kept is the smallest. Returns the "none"
    // index for a vertex no face uses.
    FirstCornerOfVertex(self: PolygonMesh3D, vertex: VertexIndex): CornerIndex
        => CornerIndex(self.CornerCount
            .MapRange(i => self.CornerCount - 1 - i)
            .Reduce(-1, (found, c) => self.Faces.Values[c].Equals(vertex) ? c : found));
```
